



You gather sonic energy and can expel as a shockwave in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 3d8 thunder damage is knocked 10 feet away. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and is not knocked away.

You can create a new shockwave as your action on subsequent turns until the spell ends.

higher_level_description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.
